edit.description: A new field-less `Predicate` variant for the engine check beside `Fresh`/`LocusDeclared` (:549), its wire label in both directions (:713 parse, :826 render), and its arm in the four classification chains (:864, :913, :966, :1017) — model the whole shape on `LocusDeclared`, which names no field either.

The variant's arms in the eight exhaustive matches that already list `Fresh | LocusDeclared` (:350, :410, :461, :641, :836, :1563, :2165, :3677) — selection, admissibility, field-lessness, root-only binding — and `root_clause` (:754) is the lookup the gate resolves it through.

Wire the judge beside the `locus-declared` (:699) and `fresh` (:742) root clauses: compare the committed lock's recorded engine against `crate::VERSION` and report at the clause's declared severity. Offline and lock-only — a lock recording no engine, and a run with no committed lock at all, report nothing.
The variant's arm in the predicate projection (:135-139), where `Fresh`/`LocusDeclared` already sit — a root predicate contributes no field schema.
The predicate constructor beside `fresh` (:262) and `locusDeclared` (:281), field-less, with the doc comment stating what it judges.

`rootDefaultContract` (:134) gains a fourth clause at `advisory`, with `guidance` and a `cite` like its three siblings — the doc comment above it says 'three clauses' and states why each is root-only; it moves with the addition.
Regenerated data, never hand-edited: the root clause family gains the new row. Regenerate by the memberless emit its own header documents.
The frozen lane's expected root clause list (:169, :195) gains the row — this is the byte-compare that proves the embedded lock was derived, not transcribed.
The root contract's clause census (:348) gains the fourth entry, plus a case that a lock recording a different engine yields the advisory finding and one recording this engine yields none.
The oracle's exhaustive predicate match (:193) gains the variant.
The emitted lock's root clause rows in the snapshot gain the new row.
The `rootDefaultContract` census (:234) and the constructor's row round-trip (:277) gain the fourth predicate.
The emitted clause-row expectation (:250-261) enumerates the root default's clauses positionally; it gains the fourth.

summary: A root default clause, advisory, reports when the committed lock records an engine version other than the one running the gate.

tests.asserts: a lock recording a different engine version reports the advisory finding naming both versions; a matching lock, a lock recording none, and a run with no lock report nothing
the embedded built-in lock's root clause family matches the SDK-derived one, the new clause included
the shipped root default contract binds the new predicate at advisory with guidance and a cite

acceptance: cargo test and pnpm --dir sdk test green, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, and the regenerated src/builtin_lock.toml passing the frozen byte-compare.
notes: Decision 0069, second consequence. Advisory because no adopter turns red on the upgrade — the same posture the root's three shipped clauses hold. Blocked on three tags for file overlap: the lock column it reads (its real dependency), src/gate.rs, and sdk/test/emit.test.ts. Widening a shared enumeration: the `Predicate` sites above are the full `rg Predicate::LocusDeclared` census at scoping. scoped at 1c049fae
